title: Visual and responsive assurance overlay

any: layout, typography, spacing, visual hierarchy, tokens, responsive behavior, overflow, or state rendering changes
a mockup or Figma comparison is required

skill_calls.when: rendered or prototype visual evidence is available

nodes.obligation: Compare named viewports and states against current design, brand, token, and layout rules.

tests.evidence: named viewports and states have screenshot-backed findings without blind snapshot acceptance

workline_policy: Attach to design, prototype, or frontend; split only for a separate visual evidence batch or approval boundary.
omission_rule: NOT_APPLICABLE when rendering, layout, hierarchy, responsive behavior, tokens, states, and visual evidence expectations are unchanged.
repair: Visual failure reopens only affected viewport/state implementation or design decisions.
